app.name: The Career Lab
app.philosophy: Actionable, evidence-based career tools for ambitious professionals.

navGuide.title: How The Career Lab Works
navGuide.subtitle: Understand the platform journey in 6 simple steps
navGuide.step1Desc: Your central repository. Add your real roles, projects, and metrics here once.
navGuide.step2Desc: Filter and weight your real accomplishments to match a target job without inventing text.
navGuide.step3Desc: Turn raw anecdotes into 30s, 90s, and deep-dive interview-ready story cards.
navGuide.step4Desc: Calibrate your scope and leadership against Big Tech levels (L4 to L7).
navGuide.step5Desc: Practice live adaptive mock interviews with turn memory and instant scoring.
navGuide.step6Desc: Simulate comp negotiation with US/LATAM/EU benchmarks, counter-tactics, and scripts.
